idea: In preterm infants, transfusing 20 mL/kg instead of 15 mL/kg of red cells reduces the number of transfusions without more adverse events.
produced_by: one standard VP run on the idea, then a recommendation by the same model

hypotheses.statement: A larger volume per transfusion lowers the number of transfusions.
Transfusion thresholds, not volumes, drive the count.

tests.title: Pool the randomised neonatal volume trials
tests.unexpected_under_both: More transfusions with the larger volume.

recommendation.reason: Several randomised trials report fewer transfusions with the larger volume.
